record.title: Observe stock bypass mmap failure through a disposable kernel-path control
record.intent: Test whether a failed real mmap explains the prior low-address fault without application injection.
requirements: Preserve stock APK and library bytes and executable instructions.
Limit device substitution to a disposable guest alias from the absent bypass path to dev-null.
Do not supply hardware register values or access physical instruments or change host security.
acceptance: Pin the available native syscall observer and validate it with a deterministic file-open control.
Observe stock open and mmap results and first fault, or preserve the exact observer availability or permission failure.
Record process maps, guest policy state, stock hashes, system_server stability and complete teardown.
Distinguish kernel syscall evidence from static interpretation and instrumentation limitations.
